searchText: Is there any place that tracks the various branches/forks representing the current development head for the different repos? If not maybe a pinned message here with the list would be helpful. Foraging around, I've found: https://github.com/dankrad/c-kzg/commits/4844 for `c-kzg`. For geth is this the fork with the latest stuff? https://github.com/mdehoog/go-ethereum/tree/devnet-v3 And for Prysm looks like some 4844-related commits are landing in develop, but there's also 4844 and 4844-containers 🤔 Yes for ckzg and geth forks, I’m not sure about prysm Prysm branch is here: https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/11621 Still WIP When having to retrieve an unknown parent of block around the eip-4844 fork, which ReqResp method should I use; beaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot or beaconBlocksByRoot? - beaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot: If the block happens to be before the fork will clients error the request or return empty? - beaconBlocksByRoot: If the block happens to be after the eip-4844 will this method return empty, error code, or no longer by suported? Is the best strategy then to just try both around the fork? For `beaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot` what should happen if you request multiple roots, some of which are pre eip-4844 and some after? Why has `BeaconBlocksByRootV2` to be disabled after eip-4844 fork? If we will eventually decouple blocks and blobs makes sense to keep it. It may also unlock some optimizations that clients may want to implement

excerpts.author: dapplion
excerpts.content:
When having to retrieve an unknown parent of block around the eip-4844 fork, which ReqResp method should I use; beaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot or beaconBlocksByRoot?
- beaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot: If the block happens to be before the fork will clients error the request or return empty?
- beaconBlocksByRoot: If the block happens to be after the eip-4844 will this method return empty, error code, or no longer by suported?

Is the best strategy then to just try both around the fork?

excerpts.content: For `beaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot` what should happen if you request multiple roots, some of which are pre eip-4844 and some after?
